captions.detailed: A vertical-rise rod blocker featuring a thick central post colored red with a white horizontal band in the middle and a rounded red top. Below this post is a grey circular road flange base. A smaller, vertical grey and red blocker rod is positioned next to the main post, extending upwards through a guide sleeve. This secondary rod moves along a vertical prismatic joint, sliding straight up and down through its mounting sleeve.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a vertical-rise rod blocker. It should feature a main red post with a white reflective band and a rounded top, mounted on a circular grey flange, alongside a secondary vertical blocker rod that translates up and down prismatically through a guide sleeve.
captions.factory: The code constructs a base assembly containing a circular flange plate and guide sleeve using Cylinder primitives. A main post is modeled by combining a Cylinder with a rounded Sphere cap, using colored segments for the red and white bands. A separate movable part is created for the secondary rod, consisting of a smaller cylinder and spherical tip, which is linked to the base via a prismatic joint to allow vertical translation.
